name: Personalization Layer
description: Add personal_signals extraction, personal searches, enhanced Reflection Agent
dependencies: Phase 2 complete (feeds generating for all users)

tasks.title: Create signal extraction tool
tasks.description: Create v1/tools/extract_signal.py that uses LLM to extract a specific follow-up query from user's note on an upvoted item.
acceptance_criteria: Takes item_title and user_note as input
Uses OpenAI API to extract specific topic/query (2-5 words)
Returns: {'query': 'GRPO reinforcement learning', 'confidence': 0.9}
Returns None if note is too generic or unrelated
Can be run: python v1/tools/extract_signal.py --title 'DeepSeek R1' --note 'GRPO is fascinating'
Outputs: {"query": "GRPO deep dive", "confidence": 0.85}
tasks.verification_command: python v1/tools/extract_signal.py --title 'LLM Finetuning' --note 'LoRA is so cool' | grep -q 'LoRA' && echo '✓ Signal extracted'

tasks.title: Enhance Reflection Agent
tasks.description: Create v1/agents/reflection.py that reads interactions, updates tag scores (like v0), AND creates personal_signals from notes.
acceptance_criteria: Reads user_interactions/{uid}/daily/{date}
Updates user_patterns/{uid}/tags scores (+5 upvote, -15 downvote)
For interactions with notes: calls extract_signal.py
Creates personal_signals in user_patterns: [{signal_id, query, priority, created_at, expires_at}]
Signals expire after 72 hours
Can be run: python v1/agents/reflection.py --user_id abc123 --date 2026-01-18
Outputs: 'Updated 8 tags, created 2 personal signals'
tasks.verification_command: python v1/agents/reflection.py --user_id test_user --date 2026-01-18 && echo '✓ Reflection complete'

tasks.title: Add personal search to Feed Delivery
tasks.description: Enhance v1/agents/feed_delivery.py to check for personal_signals and run targeted searches for those queries.
acceptance_criteria: Reads user_patterns/{uid}/personal_signals
Filters out expired signals (> 72 hours old)
For each active signal: runs Tavily search for signal.query (max 5 results)
Merges personal items (20%) with pool items (80%)
Total feed still 20 items
Personal items are marked with metadata: {from_personal_signal: true}
Logs: 'Found 2 active signals, added 4 personal items'
tasks.verification_command: python v1/agents/feed_delivery.py --user_id test_user | python -c 'import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); personal=[i for i in data if i.get("metadata",{}).get("from_personal_signal")]; print("✓ Personal items:", len(personal))'

tasks.title: Create daily reflection job
tasks.description: Create v1/run_daily_reflection.py that runs reflection for all users at end of day (11 PM).
acceptance_criteria: Queries user_profiles where onboarded=true
For each user, runs reflection.py with today's date
Handles errors gracefully
Logs progress: 'Running reflection for 150 users... [50/150]'
Can be run: python v1/run_daily_reflection.py
Outputs: 'Reflection complete for 150 users in 45s'
tasks.verification_command: python v1/run_daily_reflection.py && echo '✓ Daily reflection complete'

tasks.title: Test personalization flow end-to-end
tasks.description: Manual verification that personal_signals work correctly. This is NOT code - just a checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Upvote an item in frontend with note: 'Vector databases are cool'
Run: python v1/agents/reflection.py --user_id {your_uid} --date {today}
Check Firestore: user_patterns/{uid} has personal_signals with 'vector databases' query
Run: python v1/generate_feed.py --user_id {your_uid}
Frontend shows new feed with some items about vector databases
After 3 days, signal expires and those items stop appearing

tasks.title: Add signal cleanup job
tasks.description: Create v1/scripts/cleanup_expired_signals.py that removes expired signals from all users. Runs daily.
acceptance_criteria: Queries user_patterns for all users
For each user, filters personal_signals where expires_at < now
Updates user_patterns to remove expired signals
Logs: 'Cleaned 47 expired signals from 23 users'
Can be run: python v1/scripts/cleanup_expired_signals.py

tasks.title: Create master scheduler
tasks.description: Create v1/scheduler.py that orchestrates all daily jobs in correct order. This is the ONE script to run via cron.
acceptance_criteria: 4:00 AM: run_daily_batch.py (Trend Discovery + Pool Harvest)
5:00 AM: run_user_feeds.py (Generate feeds for all users)
11:00 PM: run_daily_reflection.py (Process day's interactions)
11:30 PM: cleanup_expired_signals.py
Each step logs start/end times
Errors in one step don't block others
Can be run: python v1/scheduler.py --jobs all
Outputs summary: 'Daily pipeline complete: 4 jobs succeeded, 0 failed, 6m 42s total'
tasks.verification_command: python v1/scheduler.py --jobs all && echo '✓ Full pipeline complete'

completion_criteria: Personal signals are extracted from user notes
Reflection updates both tag scores AND creates signals
